olivia.eng: Heads up — RCA for 04/12 throttling event is published: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1859999999-throt-rca. Short summary: mis-sized batching window + aggressive KV cache TTLs led to elevated p95s for ~18m. No customer data impacted.
postmortem-bot: New doc snapshot created by olivia.eng: https://docs.redwood/inference/postmortems/1859999999-throt-rca :robot_face:
ana.prod: Thanks. I left an "Immediate Remediations" list in the doc. Please claim items you can own.
marcus.sre: I'll take the alert tuning and runbook update. Plan: change alert threshold to 2.5x baseline and add jitter suppression for deploy windows. ETA: EOD.
olivia.eng: I'll push the minimal batching rollback and include the reverted commit ID. PR link will be in the doc.
dev-support: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note and a FAQ snippet. Can someone confirm affected customers list?
olivia.eng: Affected customers are in Appendix A (small set of high-throughput tenants). dev-support, I'll DM you access to the list.
ana.prod: Quick copy of action items here:
- I1: Rollback batching change + PR 1 owner: @olivia.eng 1 due: today 18:00 PT
- I2: Alert tuning & runbook update 1 owner: @marcus.sre 1 due: tomorrow 12:00 PT
- I3: Customer note + FAQ 1 owner: @dev-support 1 due: tomorrow 11:00 PT
- I4: Add KV-TTL metric to dashboard for high-throughput models 1 owner: @ana.prod 1 due: Fri 9:00 PT
ana.prod: Proposing a 20-min sync Wed 09:30 PT to confirm closures. React with :thumbsup: if that works.
marcus.sre: +1 works for me.
dev-support: +1
olivia.eng: I'll try to make it. If blocked, will update the doc.
postmortem-bot: Calendar invite created: "Follow-up: 04/12 throttling RCA" Wed 09:30 PT 1 https://calendar.redwood/ev/1859999999-followup
ana.prod: Thanks everyone, please mark items done in the doc as you finish so I can draft the exec note once I see I1-I3 closed.
